description: Fallow quality baseline. Counters may shrink but not grow; averageMaintainability may rise but not drop. Regenerate with `npm run check:quality -- --update` (commit the diff in the same PR that moves the metric). The do-date increment (PR #75) lowered averageMaintainability 91.8->91.7 — the reviewed reason is recorded in docs/Gaps.md GAP-74 (that entry's complexFunctions 13->15 bump was retired by a later refactor, per the same GAP). The Task Detail increment (PR #76) lowered it 91.7->91.6: adding the real async useTaskDetail composable (own MI 87.7, in line with its siblings useTaskSchedule 88.0 / useTaskReorderCommit 86.6 / useTaskDisplay 86.2 — not a factoring problem) pulls the repo-wide average down ~0.1 at this rounding edge; every counter metric (complexFunctions, cloneGroups, criticalComplexity, deadCode) stayed at/under baseline, single-sourcing shared field-reflection into utils/taskMutations.ts rather than duplicating. A later Task Detail follow-up (PR #76, Codex round 27) lowered it 91.6->91.5: onOpenTask gained a required P1 guard — it must NOT open Task Detail while the row's own write is in flight, or a detail save/delete races the row write (both replace the whole document; a late field write can recreate a file Detail just deleted). The guard is one added conditional in useTaskActions.ts (already a documented LOC hotspot); a concise if/else-if form did not recover the ~0.05 rounding-edge drop, and the fix is a data-integrity requirement, so the floor moves rather than contorting the code. Every counter metric stayed at/under baseline. The screen-capture source-picker increment (phase 2 task 9) lowered it 91.5->91.4: the first frontend slice of screen capture adds five files — stores/screenCapture.ts (MI 90.0), components/ScreenSourcePicker.vue (86.3), components/ScreenAudioPicker.vue (89.1) and the two suites (88.8 / 89.7) — every one inside fallow's "good" band and in line with its siblings (ImportVaultPicker.vue 83.7, stores/capture.ts 81.3), so this is not a factoring problem: a 210-file AVERAGE falls whenever normal new code lands below the current mean, and the exact mean here is 91.4493 against a 91.45 rounding edge. Splitting the larger suite into two files was tried and recovered 0.0003 — the metric is not line-count-driven — so the floor moves rather than contorting new code to chase a rounding edge. Every counter metric stayed at or under baseline (deadCodeIssues 2, complexFunctions 13, criticalComplexity 4, cloneGroups 0, circularDependencies 0): no new complex function, clone, dead export or cycle is masked. The region source-picker tab increment (phase 3 task 7) RAISED it 91.4->91.5 — a tightening, not a loosening: the Region panel was extracted into the presentational ScreenRegionPicker.vue rather than left inline in ScreenSourcePicker.vue's template, which had pushed complexFunctions 13->14 (fallow's HIGH band, on the TEMPLATE, so a composable extraction would not have helped). Every counter metric stayed at or under baseline. The 2026-09-21 polish pass TIGHTENED three metrics by hand (never --update): deadCodeIssues 2->0 (UpdatePhase de-exported; RENAME_PROMPT_MS now consumed by the two tests that hard-coded its value; logError made module-private once logVueError became main.ts's entry point), criticalComplexity 4->3 (Recordings.vue's three-deep status-glyph ternary inside nested v-for replaced by a statusGlyph lookup), averageMaintainability 91.5->91.6 (the Search.vue / TaskDetail.vue / EditorRoot.vue extractions). The Tutorial Editor increment lowered it 91.6->91.4 (ONE consolidated sentence: later tutorial-editor tasks edit it in place, never append another). Measured at Task 21 (timeline drag/trim/nudge, the window-local clipboard, the Inspector's Clip section, and its fix round 1): the baseline tree's exact mean was 91.5555 over 301 scored files, 0.0055 above the 91.55 rounding edge, so any new file under 91.55 drops the reported value; the four new files Task 21's brief mandates -- composables/useTimelineDrag.ts (MI 89.7), components/editor/inspector/ClipSection.vue (86.3), tests/useTimelineDrag.test.ts (88.5), tests/editorClipSection.test.ts (90.1), all inside fallow's good band -- give 91.5174 on their own, so no refactor could hold 91.6. The tree after Task 21 measures 91.4506 over 308 files (also editor/clipboard.ts 89.2, tests/editorCutSaveReopen.test.ts 87.8, tests/editorClipboard.test.ts 91.8, ClipItem.vue 89.2->84.3), i.e. only 0.0006 above the next rounding edge at 91.45. Measured at Task 22 (the layered preview, after its fix round 1): the rest of the tree measures 91.4513 over 308 files; the five files the brief mandates -- editor/previewController.ts (85.0), components/editor/preview/PreviewSurface.vue (85.7), components/editor/preview/TransportBar.vue (89.7), tests/previewController.test.ts (86.1), tests/editorTransport.test.ts (87.2) -- plus the implementer's own pure split editor/previewLayers.ts (86.4) and editor/previewGeometry.ts (96.7), none in fallow's low band (maintainability_low_pct 0), give 91.3771 over 315 files. Holding 91.45 with the two suites as they are would need the five source files (controller, layers, geometry, surface, transport) to average ~93.3 (sum 466.45) against today's 88.7 -- lifting the controller and the surface by about 8 points each is not an honest refactor, so the floor moves. Floor never below 91.0. Every counter metric held: complexFunctions 13, criticalComplexity 3, deadCodeIssues 0, cloneGroups 0, circularDependencies 0.
